_comment: Cards for tests/unit/ledger/test_graveyard_plays_this_turn.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_drudge_watcher` is Laboratory Drudge's end-step line alone on an artifact (the "if" follows the effect, so it is checked on resolution only, not an intervening if); `t_flashback_cantrip` is an instant cast from hand or flashed back; `t_grave_lifegain` has one ability activated from the graveyard by exiling itself (an unearth's shape), and `t_board_lifegain` the same ability activated on the battlefield, as the counterfactual.

cards.name: Test Drudge Watcher
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of each end step, draw a card if you've cast a spell from a graveyard or activated an ability of a card in a graveyard this turn.

abilities.text: At the beginning of each end step, draw a card if you've cast a spell from a graveyard or activated an ability of a card in a graveyard this turn.
